description: Unit test class for ChangeOperation comparison logic in the loan account transaction processing module of the Fineract project. Contains tests that verify order and comparison of ChangeOperation instances based on dates and creation times.

classes.name: ChangeOperationTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for comparing ChangeOperation instances based on various date criteria for loan transaction processing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up static mock for ThreadLocalContextUtil to return a fixed tenant with timezone 'Europe/Budapest'.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes the static mock for ThreadLocalContextUtil.

methods.name: testCompareToEqual
methods.description: Tests the compareTo method for two ChangeOperations with identical dates and creation times, expecting equality.

methods.name: testCompareToEqualBackdatedCharge
methods.description: Tests comparison behavior for backdated charges and transactions to ensure correct ordering.

methods.name: testComparison
methods.description: Parameterized test for comparing ChangeOperations with various date scenarios, verifies expected order.

methods.name: provideComparisonTestData
methods.description: Provides data for parameterized comparison tests with different date combinations.

methods.name: testComparatorOnDifferentSubmittedDay
methods.description: Tests the sorting order of different ChangeOperations across permutations based on submitted date.

methods.name: testComparatorOnSameDayBackdatedCharge
methods.description: Tests order for multiple backdated charges on the same day.

methods.name: testComparatorOnSameDay
methods.description: Tests order for ChangeOperations occurring on the same day.

methods.name: createInterestRateChange
methods.description: Creates a mocked ChangeOperation for interest rate change based on submitted date.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates a mocked ChangeOperation for a loan charge with specified effective, submitted, and creation dates.

methods.name: createTransaction
methods.description: Creates a mocked ChangeOperation for a loan transaction with specified transaction, submitted, and creation dates.
